Repository: maplesure-sponsor-portal ## architecture.md (verbatim) # MapleSure SponsorConnect Portal — architecture The plan-sponsor web portal for MapleSure Insurance (fictional; all data synthetic). Flask, server-rendered templates, no SPA framework. ## Components - `app.py` — routes: dashboard (`/`), member directory (`/members`), member detail (`/members/`). - `portal/members.py` — member lookup against the claims API. - `templates/` — Jinja pages; `static/portal.js` progressive enhancement. ## Data The portal stores nothing.
